CustomField.label: Specificity
CustomField.description: 1 exact pair, 2 source-family x target, 3 target-only, 4 base. The resolution chain merges every matching pack from 4 down to 1, so a lower number wins. Written by scripts/build-instrument.py from the shape of the keys rather than typed by hand, because a specificity that disagrees with its keys silently reorders the merge.
